messages:
Evan: Heads-up: I'm starting a small refresh for the 'Hello Lite' quickstart to clarify auth and the first deploy path. Main goals: unify env var name, add one-file deploy (Docker), and swap curl to our v1 API.
Samira: SG. Please make env var REDWOOD_KEY across the examples. We've been auditing for that.
Evan: Will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534 (WIP)  changes: /get-started/hello-lite.md, /examples/docker-hello.md
DocBot: PR #534 opened by Evan  CI: pending  reviewers requested: @Jae, @Priya
Jae: Quick note: the current curl example POSTs to /v0/generate. Update to /v1/generate and show minimal JSON body.
Priya: Also add a 1-line caution about not committing long-lived keys to repos and link to /security/tokens.
Evan: Proposed curl snippet to land in PR:
```bash
# exchange short-lived session token on your backend
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/token/exchange \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SESSION_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"scope":"inference:basic"}'

# call generation (server-side)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-1-small","input":"Hello from Redwood"}'
```
Samira: Nice. For the Docker example, prefer --env-file and show a tiny compose block for local testing.
Evan: Adding compose and single-file Docker run. Tiny docker snippet I included: ```dockerfile
FROM node:18
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --production
COPY . .
CMD ["node","server.js"]
# run locally: docker run --env-file .env -p 8080:8080 hello-lite:latest
```
Jae: One more: the Node snippet uses top-level await. Wrap in an async function for Node 14 compat or set node:18 in snippet metadata.
Evan: I'll set node:18 in the snippet metadata and add a one-line migration note for older Node.
DocBot: CI checks queued for PR #534  checks: markdown-lint, link-check, snippet-run (node:18, python:3)
Priya: Reviewed wording around client-side tokens. Tiny suggestion: change "in-browser demos" paragraph to explicitly say "use short-lived tokens issued by your backend".
Evan: Updated copy and pushed. PR ready for re-review.
DocBot: CI passed for PR #534  status: green
Jae: Approved.
Evan: Merged PR #534  commit: b7e9c2d  docs build queued
Samira: Thanks! I'll run a quick grep across docs tomorrow for REDWOOD_API_KEY references and open follow-ups.
Priya: Small win  improves onboarding clarity. :tada:
